notes.title: Worm Over It in Linux and SteamOS!
notes.notes: [p]I'd KILL YOU as a Worm can now be played on Linux and SteamOS so you should be able to start worming your way through your garden on your steamdeck! (although that hasn't actually been fully tested yet) [/p][p][/p][p]This update also brings the game onto the Godot 4.4 engine to make it just that much better! happy worming and keep climbing[/p]

notes.title: It Probably Wor(m)ks Now! (Version 1.1 - 29-05-25)
notes.notes:
- fixed issues with failing to launch from steam
- made it so when you reset the game follows the player
- fixed unlocking achievements from crashing the game

sorry this took so long, I'm in the middle of exams!

notes.title: Time to Worm Over It!
notes.notes:
The [b]most difficult and awesome worm based platformer[/b] [i](probably)[/i] is finally available! It's time to test your skills in worming to see if you can [b]take out your ex-boyfriend[/b]. You will fall. But that's all the more reason to keep climbing!
